implementationSummary: Remediated all 4 P1 generalized defects identified in CAL_020_REMEDIATION_001: (1) Valuation metric-level coverage gating: buildHistoricalContext now evaluates dated observations per metric. If valid observations < 2, returns null median/range/percentile and coverage INSUFFICIENT. Valuation dataCompleteness is derived from metric-level coverage (MINIMAL when metrics lack qualifying history; never FULL without multi-observation dense history). (2) QGLP Risk FERE gating: NO_RED_FLAG_DETECTED is emitted only when FERE is WORKING and backed by indexed filings evidence, citing FERE evidence directly. When FERE is DATA_INSUFFICIENT or lacks filings, risk emits DATA_INSUFFICIENT (never citing Upstox competitor snapshots). (3) Model-aware QGLP leverage: BANK and NBFC receive model-appropriate NOT_APPLICABLE status citing prudential and ALM norms. Non-financials gate on actual debtTrajectory status (DELEVERAGING -> SUPPORTED, STABLE -> PARTIAL, absent/insufficient -> DATA_INSUFFICIENT). (4) Business model classification & fail-closed routing: BusinessModelClassifier classifies legal company names containing financial terms as NBFC when sector/industry are missing. FundamentalModuleAdapter withholds model-dependent margin, debt, and return interpretations for UNKNOWN business models. QGLP withholds working capital and leverage conclusions for UNKNOWN models.
